ensemble_hypotheses.name: ORB ∩ LUNCH same-day filter
ensemble_hypotheses.mechanism: Trade F2-ORB only on days LUNCH_OPEN also fires in same direction (or only when LUNCH morning residual agrees with ORB breakout side).
ensemble_hypotheses.why_plausible: LUNCH_OPEN is afternoon US indices mean-reversion/continuation after morning move; ORB is morning breakout — low raw ρ expected; AND-filter may cut false ORB days and raise per-trade edge at cost of N.

ensemble_hypotheses.name: ORB + BTC regime gate
ensemble_hypotheses.mechanism: Size ORB normally; add BTC US-open sleeve only when BTC realized vol or prior-day range ≥ median (cost/vol screen already favors BTC).
ensemble_hypotheses.why_plausible: S2-BTC has large bruto (+18.5 bp mean net) but power-FAIL; regime gate may stabilize N while keeping diversifier ρ≈0.11 with ORB.
ensemble_hypotheses.data_note: ρ(ORB,BTC)≈0.11297937765376753; BTC N=132. Power fix = more instruments (ETH/SOL pool) not threshold-mining on same 132.
ensemble_hypotheses.status: hypothesis_only — prefer S2b/S2c-style pre-registered pools over filters

ensemble_hypotheses.name: Stack small edges → SR≈1 (equal-vol book)

ensemble_hypotheses.why_plausible: D-091 ambition grid: SR≳1 needed for €800/m. Single sleeves sit SR≈0.7–1.1; low pairwise ρ (see corr matrix) can lift book SR toward 1.2–1.3 on paper.
